result:
Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` promised to "trim outer whitespace" but didn't. Removing the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed.

I added `.strip()` to its return value. That fixes `is_activity_label_prompt` and every other caller of `strip_reminders`.

I checked your example directly and `is_activity_label_prompt` now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite because pytest isn't installed in this environment.
